reason: The new sendAddGuestsEmails in packages/emails/email-manager.ts (patch lines 218-243) only takes (calEvent, newGuests) and sends organizer, team-member and attendee emails without any check. That differs from sendLocationChangeEmails just above it (email-manager.ts:503,515), which checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail/eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail. addGuests.handler.ts calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) without booking.eventType?.metadata (patch line 592).
